title: JPMorgan launches $8 billion bond sale for EA buyout
title_zh: 摩根大通发行 80 亿美元债券以收购 EA
summary: JPMorgan Chase kicked off an $8 billion junk bond sale on March 23 to finance the $55 billion leveraged buyout of Electronic Arts. It is the largest leveraged buyout in history.
summary_zh: 摩根大通于 3 月 23 日开始发行 80 亿美元的垃圾债券，为艺电公司 550 亿美元的杠杆收购提供资金。这是历史上最大的杠杆收购。

title: Adobe Links Semrush Deal And NVIDIA Alliance To AI Marketing Future
title_zh: Adobe 将 Semrush 交易和 NVIDIA 联盟与 AI 营销的未来联系起来
summary: Adobe, ticker NasdaqGS:ADBE, plans to acquire marketing platform Semrush for US$1.9b. The company also announced an expanded partnership with NVIDIA focused on next generation Firefly models and AI agent workflows.
summary_zh: Adobe（股票代码 NasdaqGS：ADBE）计划以 1.9 亿美元收购营销平台 Semrush。该公司还宣布扩大与 NVIDIA 的合作伙伴关系，重点关注下一代 Firefly 模型和 AI 代理工作流程。

title: Is Rivian's $1.25 Billion Robotaxi Deal With Uber Really a Good One for Shareholders?
title_zh: Rivian 与 Uber 的 12.5 亿美元机器人出租车交易对股东来说真的是一件好事吗？
summary: Rivian had to abandon a long-standing profitability goal to make the deal with Uber. Was it worth it?
summary_zh: Rivian 不得不放弃长期的盈利目标才能与 Uber 达成交易。值得吗？

title: OpenAI Discontinues Support for Sora, Winds Down Disney Deal
title_zh: OpenAI 停止支持 Sora，终止迪士尼交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- OpenAI plans to discontinue its Sora AI video generator six months after the high-profile launch of a standalone app for the service, as the company works to simplify its portfolio of artificial intelligence products. The ChatGPT maker and Walt Disney Co.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——OpenAI 计划在高调推出该服务的独立应用程序六个月后停止其 Sora AI 视频生成器，因为该公司致力于简化其人工智能产品组合。 ChatGPT 制造商和华特迪士尼公司。
